rows.grounds: fused token keeps verb plus instrumental and pronoun; @ marks sandhi fusion

items.question: What merit is counted for one who worships by this rite?
premises: Worship is performed by this rite.
items.inference: The rite's merit transcends ordinary reckoning.
uncertainties: Exact sandhi split of the fused first token is not expanded.
items.plain_english: Worship by this rite; its merit is not counted.
